summary.text: Steve Johnson is an independent candidate for Idaho State Senate District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Scott Herndon.
His career experience includes working as an educator, farmer, rancher and small-scale logger.

paragraphs.text: Steve Johnson earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Idaho in 1972 and a graduate degree in 1988.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said his family bought its farm in 1957, that he had worked as a railroad laborer, farmhand, small-scale logger, rancher, farmer and small business owner, and that he spent most of a 42-year education career in District 1 as a teacher and principal.
Johnson ran as an independent write-in candidate for Idaho State Senate District 1 in 2022, receiving 40.9 percent of the vote to Republican Scott Herndon's 59.1 percent.
In that survey, he listed doubling the homeowner's exemption to $250,000, funding public education and preserving open spaces, rural lifestyle and public land access as his key messages.
